spec.title: Query Performance (agents_overview)
spec.description: Per-panel ClickHouse query cost for agents_overview.json, sourced from system.query_log via the log_comment tag set by tag_panel_queries.py. Mirrors agents_overview.json's tab structure.

spec.name: query_id
spec.label: Query ID
spec.description: Set via a query_id column link elsewhere in this dashboard, not typed by hand.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT event_time AS time, query_duration_ms
FROM system.query_log
WHERE log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_95' AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time AS time, memory_usage
FROM system.query_log
WHERE log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_95' AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time AS time, read_rows, read_bytes
FROM system.query_log
WHERE log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_95' AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms) AS p50,
  quantile(0.9)(query_duration_ms) AS p90,
  quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95
FROM system.query_log
WHERE log_comment = 'agents_overview:panel_95' AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
